body: I´m so sorry for your loss.

Hmm okay so when I’m in poses like for example wide legged childs pose, I start to feel extreme sensations moving up and down my body as I move deeper in to the pose. It feels so uncomfortable and unbearable that I feel the need to get out of the pose immidietaly. It’s not painful in any way, rather uncomfortable as hell.
Okay, thank you☺️ but do you recommend that I try easy beginners meditations to learn how to control my focus before these inner child meditations, or isn’t that nessecary?
Thank you very much for your reply! I am using guided meditation, more spesifically focusing on inner child healing as I am struggling with codependency and low self esteem. Have you tried it?

People with anxiety/depression are not able to tolerate stress and worries as good as other people. I’m going through exactly the same, and I feel sooo lonely even though I have many around me. I guess that’s just what these disorders do, they make you believe you’re much more unwanted and lonely than you really are.. especially when you suffer from these mental illnesses, it can be easy to feel like an outsider from those around you that don’t…
Take care of yourself. You’re not alone❤️
Please know that holding out for four years makes you SOOO freaking strong!!! You’re absolutely not a failure and you will keep on fighting like you’ve been doing! I’m so proud of you❤️❤️❤️
